fssai_standards.regulation_title: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011
fssai_standards.processing_aid_vs_retained_additive_dist: Under FSSAI rules, a substance used during conditioning that is washed off and has no technical effect in the finished food is a Processing Aid. However, when citrate/K+/Na+ penetrates the cotyledon to chelate middle-lamella calcium and accelerate home cooking, internal pore solute (~250-450 mg/100g) remains in the dry grain. Therefore, for retail/institutional transparency and strict regulatory compliance, the product must either declare 'Acidity Regulators / Sequestrants (INS 332, INS 331, INS 330)' on the ingredient label or be marketed as 'Conditioned Quick-Cooking Toor Dal'.

iso_sensory_standards.title: Sensory analysis — Methodology — General guidance for conducting hedonic tests with consumers in a controlled area
mandatory_controls: Williams Latin Square counterbalanced serving order
Controlled temperature (65 +/- 2°C at serving) and standardized dal:water ratio (1:3.5 w/w)
Evaluation in both unspiced boiled state (worst-case off-note detection) and standardized tadka state
Minimum N = 72-100 naive regular toor dal consumers for TOST equivalence power >= 90%
